svg.title: Orbit Remote request authorisation path
svg.desc: Ten checks in order. Before TLS: a connection budget of 128 connections, 32 per source; otherwise the socket is closed. During the TLS handshake: a usable client certificate, or the handshake fails and is audited; the link policy, or the connection is dropped. On every request: browser headers refused with 403; a per-address rate limit of 120 a second and 6 pairing requests a minute, 429; the Tailscale source check, 403 and audited; the certificate pin against an unrevoked pairing, 401 and audited. On the route: the owner decision, 401 if revoked or 403 ended_by_owner if blocked; device and session grants, session ownership and resume epoch, 404 or 410; per-device limits, 429 or 409. Then the handler runs and re-checks authority after every wait and native step; streams re-check every 250 ms.
